name: Gankoomon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, if [Gankoomon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, none of your Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with [Sistermon] or [Huckmon] in their names or the [Royal Knight] trait gain ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon is [Jesmon GX] all of your Digimon gain ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
